meta.endpoint: GET /api/v1/area_map/district-area-agri?province_code=<code>&year=<BE year>  (also tried year=2567 and 2568 for a handful of provinces — payload was byte-identical between the two years, i.e. this endpoint is not really time-series per district; it reflects the latest baked-in snapshot regardless of the year param passed)
meta.label: MEASURED-official (NABC/OAE administrative district data), amphoe grain, CROP-AGNOSTIC (total district land area + total agricultural land area only — no per-crop breakdown; see nabc_amphoe_crops.json for why a crop breakdown does not exist on this portal)
meta.coverage: All 77/77 provinces returned data. 932 raw amphoe rows (928 unique province+amphoe keys expected to match th_amphoe.geojson's national 928-amphoe count; 4 keys are duplicated in the source — see caveat).

fields.district_area_sqkm: API field `area`. Units INFERRED (not labelled by the API): matches known amphoe land area in km^2, e.g. Mueang Nakhon Ratchasima = 755.596 vs its real-world ~757 km^2. Treat as approx, not re-verified per-amphoe.
fields.agri_area_rai: API field `agri_area`. Units INFERRED as rai by order-of-magnitude match against OAE's usual agricultural-area figures (a district-level total in the hundreds of thousands of rai is consistent with rai, not km^2 or hectares).

meta.caveat_duplicate_rows: 4 (province_code, amphoe) keys appear TWICE in the raw pull, both times named 'เมือง' (Mueang, i.e. the provincial-capital district), each with a DIFFERENT agri_area value: province_code 30 (นครราชสีมา), 33 (ศรีสะเกษ), 45 (ร้อยเอ็ด), 52 (ลำปาง). For นครราชสีมา specifically, one of the two 'เมือง' rows carries agri_area=152115.00, which is IDENTICAL to the neighboring 'เมืองยาง' district's own agri_area in the same payload — strongly suggesting a copy/paste or join error at the SOURCE (NABC's own backend), not an artifact of this pull. Both rows are kept as-is (flagged via `duplicate_amphoe_key_in_source: true`) rather than guessing which value is correct — do not silently sum or average them.
meta.cross_check_suggestion: This is a natural cross-check / alternative input for pipeline/build_amphoe.py's own amphoe-area computation (currently derived from th_amphoe.geojson polygon area) and for an agri-land-share metric (agri_area_rai / (district_area_sqkm*625)).
